complexity.notes: Encode is clean and linear. Decode would be O(n) if it used an index pointer into the original string instead of reslicing s each loop; the repeated s = s[k:] copies dominate the runtime. Also note int(s[0:a]) is computed twice per iteration and could be stored in a variable.
complexity.summary: Encodes each string as a length-prefixed token (len|s). Decoding repeatedly finds the delimiter, slices out the string, and reassigns s to the sliced remainder, which copies the remaining characters every iteration and makes decode quadratic in the total character volume.
